description: Block pushes when repository documentation checks fail.

hooks.command: command=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty') || { echo 'Documentation hook could not inspect the pending command.' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s\n' "$command" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|][[:space:]]*)(rtk[[:space:]]+)?git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo 'Documentation hook could not find the repository root.' >&2; exit 2; }; cd "$root" || { echo 'Documentation hook could not enter the repository root.' >&2; exit 2; }; rumdl check . --deny-config-warnings >&2 || { echo 'Push blocked: rumdl failed.' >&2; exit 2; }; vale --glob='!{**/AGENTS.md,**/CLAUDE.md,docs/templates/*.md}' --minAlertLevel=error README.md ui/README.md docs >&2 || { echo 'Push blocked: Vale failed.' >&2; exit 2; }
